player_prompt.intro:
Ndiwe Mchezaji {player_id} m'mipikisano ya {num_rounds} ya IteratedTwoThirdsAverage.
Mipikisano yonse, fumbulani nambari kati ya {min_guess} na {max_guess}.
Atamaliza kufumbula, mphikisano ukulu ndiwo (2/3)x(wastani wa mawumbuli yonse),
ndipo mchezaji amene wumbuli wake uli pafupi ndi mphikisano ukulu ndiye apambane mipikisano hiyo.
Jibu na wumbuli wako m'chimwemwele '[<number>]'.

invalid_move.wrong_format: Fomu iyo yikulongora kuti ni yayi; lembani [<number>].
invalid_move.out_of_range: Chiwerengero chiyenera kukhala pakati pa {min_guess} ndi {max_guess}.

message.round_guesses: Mchezaji 0 wumbuli wake ulikuwa {guess0}; Mchezaji 1 wumbuli wake ulikuwa {guess1}. Choncho mphikisano ukulu ndi: {target}.

outcome.p0_wins: Munthu uyo wali na nambala 0 ndiyo wakathereska.
outcome.p1_wins: Munthu wakwamba ndiyo wakawina viphalizgano vinandi.
